QueueState.title: QueueState
QueueState.description: Floor up system state representing the current queue, presets, daily stats, and recent activity log.

reps.description: List of reps on the board with their order, up counts, status, and check-in state.

presets.description: Preset rep names available for quick addition.

lastResetDate.description: Date string (YYYY-MM-DD) when the daily stats were last reset.

autoResetEnabled.description: Whether midnight daily reset is active.

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp when state was last updated.

/queue_state/{stateId}.description: Singleton state document storing the shared store floor queue.
